title: Small free finite-coproduct envelope and coherent extension of diagrams
statement:
Use the universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal U'$ of [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category], with small meaning $\mathcal U$-small, and simplicial sets, quasicategories, coherent functor categories, transformations and mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. A finite coproduct means a colimit of a diagram indexed by a finite discrete simplicial set, with the empty diagram included; preservation means sending every such colimiting cocone to a colimiting cocone. For every small simplicial set $K$ there exist a small quasicategory $J$ admitting finite coproducts, including an initial object, and a simplicial map $i:K\to J$ with the following properties. Every object of $J$ is equivalent to a finite coproduct of vertices $i(k)$, with the empty coproduct allowed. For every quasicategory $\mathcal E$ in the larger universe which admits finite coproducts, and every coherent diagram $F:K\to\mathcal E$, there exist a coherent functor $\widehat F:J\to\mathcal E$ preserving finite coproducts and a coherent equivalence $\eta:F\simeq\widehat F i$. For every coherent functor $H:J\to\mathcal E$, restriction followed by precomposition with $\eta$ is an equivalence of whole mapping spaces
$$
\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(J,\mathcal E)}(\widehat F,H)\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal E)}(F,Hi),\qquad t\longmapsto (ti)\eta,
$$
naturally in $H$, including all higher simplices. No preservation property is required of $H$, and no local smallness, accessibility or cocompleteness is assumed of $\mathcal E$.

source.place: Remark 5.3.5.9 (free completion under finite coproducts, with its left Kan extension property); Proposition 5.3.6.2 for the completion universal property; Section 4.3.2 for left Kan extensions. The arbitrary simplicial-set version passes first to a small categorical fibrant replacement. No Stacks tag states this infinity-categorical construction.
